question: Will this compile? What happens when you run it? Explain your reasoning.
answer: It does not compile. Line 1 and line 4 are missing the ; at the end, so javac reports ';' expected. After those are fixed, system.out still fails because Java is case-sensitive: there is no package called system, it must be System. Even then the indentation is misleading: without braces only i++ is in the loop, a silent logic error whenever a braceless loop is followed by indented lines.
